prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE polished full-screen portrait mobile idle racing game DAILY GIFTS popup concept, concept 3: compact near-square tiles in a 3-column by 2-row grid. Target aspect ratio 886:1920 (390x845 logical). Render a straight-on finished game UI, no phone frame, no perspective.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND ICON reference: preserve the glossy miniature ticket and purple gem icon identities, cyan gift header, red close X, orange claim button. Redesign the layout and text as specified below; do NOT copy unwanted reward names from the reference.
Style: Soft Miniature, warm cream/beige rounded popup, softly bevelled edges, subtle shadows, tactile glossy 3D icons, navy readable Vietnamese rounded bold text. Tiny margins around a nearly full-screen popup against a subtly dimmed game background. High quality and compact efficient spacing.
Top: cyan rounded header with a shiny red/gold gift box at left, exact title "QUÀ HẰNG NGÀY", a red rounded close button with white "X" at right.
Below header exact line "Đăng nhập mỗi ngày, nhận quà cực chất!" then small blue pill "Đã nhận: 0 ngày".
MAIN GRID: exactly SIX EQUAL-SIZE nearly square cards, 3 columns x 2 rows. Each card has a colored attached tab on its TOP EDGE labelled "Ngày N". Each card has a very large CENTERED glossy reward icon. A darker colored full-width strip along the BOTTOM shows ONLY the numeral quantity. No reward names, no unit words, no "gem", no "vé", no ticket names anywhere inside these six cards. All six icon areas and bottom strips aligned.
Row 1: "Ngày 1": blue Pro ticket icon from reference, bottom strip "2"; gold border, golden soft glow, small "HÔM NAY" badge integrated at the top. "Ngày 2": silver-blue Standard ticket icon, bottom strip "2". "Ngày 3": purple gem icon, bottom strip "15".
Row 2: "Ngày 4": purple/gold All-Star ticket icon, bottom strip "1". "Ngày 5": gold/purple Elite ticket icon, bottom strip "1". "Ngày 6": purple gem icon, bottom strip "20".
Below the grid a full-width special Day 7 card with cyan fill and golden border, title "NGÀY 7 · QUÀ ĐẶC BIỆT", gift box at left, purple gem icon with "30" and purple/gold All-Star ticket icon with "2" side by side. Use icons plus numbers only, avoid reward names.
Below: accumulation section exact heading "QUÀ TÍCH LŨY" with small pill "0/10 ngày". Four evenly spaced milestone markers on a thin horizontal progress track. Four compact reward columns: "Ngày 10" purple gem and quantity "40"; "Ngày 20" All-Star ticket and quantity "2"; "Ngày 30" purple gem plus All-Star ticket with quantities "80 + 2"; "Ngày 40" purple gem and quantity "40". Keep this readable with no unnecessary prose.
Bottom: large orange rounded glossy raised CTA with small gift box icon and exact white text "NHẬN QUÀ".
Mandatory avoid: NO bar or text "Hoàn thành 7 ngày để nhận", NO seven-day completion banner, NO invented extra rewards or rows, NO names of rewards in daily tiles, NO large wasted vertical spaces, NO clipping, NO watermark. Spell Vietnamese carefully. Visual hierarchy: cyan header, six large icons with clear numerals, special full-width card, compact milestones, strong orange CTA.
